# Сценарий сверки: управление ключами.

# --- подготовка ---
SET k v
RPUSH l a b c
HSET h f v

# --- переименование ---
RENAME k k2
GET k2
RENAME nosuchkey x
RENAMENX k2 k3
RENAMENX k3 k2
GET k2

# --- копирование и перенос ---
COPY k2 c1
GET c1
COPY k2 c1
COPY k2 c1 REPLACE
COPY k2 c2 DB 1
COPY k2 c3 DB 99
MOVE c1 1
MOVE c1 1
MOVE c1 0

# --- сериализация ---
~ DUMP l
~ DUMP nosuchkey

# --- сроки жизни ---
~ EXPIRETIME k2
~ PEXPIRETIME k2
~ EXPIRETIME nosuchkey
SET tmp v EX 100
~ EXPIRETIME tmp
~ PEXPIRETIME tmp

# --- базы данных ---
SWAPDB 0 1
SWAPDB 0 99

# --- кодировка ---
OBJECT ENCODING l
OBJECT ENCODING h
OBJECT ENCODING nosuchkey
~ OBJECT HELP   # the wording of the help text is not a compatibility concern

# --- сортировка ---
SORT l
SORT l ALPHA
SORT l ALPHA DESC
SORT l ALPHA LIMIT 0 2
RPUSH nums 3 1 2
SORT nums
SORT nums DESC
SORT nums STORE sorted
LRANGE sorted 0 -1
SORT nums BY w_*
